body:
## What it does

Assembles a Japanese-and-English research site about the Cybercab and then keeps it current. The page pairs a practical guide to how the vehicle is being used in Austin and across the US with credited manufacturer imagery, an interactive three-dimensional view, and an hourly refresh pulled from the company's X posts. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @bestband2016 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
